evidence.reason: The current implementation calls `callback()` before any marker cleanup or child collection. If the observation callback raises, `REPAIR_PAUSE_MARKER.unlink(...)` and `proc.communicate()`/termination are skipped, leaving the paused child and pause marker outstanding. This is an ordinary resource-cleanup defect in the existing function, not a new protection requirement; the cited line is stale (callback is now at line 2162), but the code still has the described behavior.
